title: Tree search/filter box unusable after connecting to an RDP session (RDP ActiveX Win32 focus)
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Summary

After connecting to a device (e.g. RDP) from the connection tree, the **search / filter box** at the top of the connection tree becomes unusable — clicking it and typing does nothing while the RDP tab is the active connection. In mRemoteNG 1.77.3 the search box stayed usable.

Reported by @happpyg in #139 (split out as its own issue).
